# A file is not memory; only the product writes memory

> Writing a file shows in a diff, passes review and reverts with git. Writing memory does none of those, and it is what the supervisor reads later.

Applies to `crates/**`, `app/**`.

<!-- archwarden:yours -->

## Context

_Everything between these two markers is yours. archwarden never rewrites it._

<!-- archwarden:end -->

## Considered and rejected

- **An MCP write channel straight into memory** (nothing refuses it) — The record would feed itself, and unreviewed memory would accumulate generated content that degrades every future piece of advice.
- **The supervisor writes memory, sessions do not** (nothing refuses it) — The supervisor is AI as well. The distinction does not hold.

## What keeps it

Nothing can. The distinction is between two writes to the same filesystem. Nothing in the import graph separates them.
